About the Company Nimbus Orchard Technologies was founded on 14 June 2017 in Pune, India, by Meera Kulkarni and Daniel Okafor. About the Company Nimbus Orchard Technologies was founded on 14 June 2017 in Pune, India, by Meera Kulkarni and Daniel Okafor. Today it develops cloud software for agricultural supply chains and employs 412 people across four offices. Our mission is to "make every harvest traceable from branch to shelf." We pursue this through three values: Rooted (we make long-term commitments to customers), Open (we share information early and honestly), and Curious (we run small experiments before large bets). Its fiscal year runs from 1 April to 31 March. All-hands meetings are held on the first Thursday of every month at 15:00 IST and are recorded for colleagues in other time zones.

About the Company Nimbus Orchard Technologies was founded on 14 June 2017 in Pune, India, by Meera Kulkarni and Daniel Okafor. About the Company Nimbus Orchard Technologies was founded on 14 June 2017 in Pune, India, by Meera Kulkarni and Daniel Okafor. About the Company Nimbus Orchard Technologies was founded on 14 June 2017 in Pune, India, by Meera Kulkarni and Daniel Okafor. The company began as a three-person team building scheduling software for orchard cooperatives, which explains the name. Today it develops cloud software for agricultural supply chains and employs 412 people across four offices. Our mission is to "make every harvest traceable from branch to shelf." About the Company Nimbus Orchard Technologies was founded on 14 June 2017 in Pune, India, by Meera Kulkarni and Daniel Okafor. The company began as a three-person team building scheduling software for orchard cooperatives, which explains the name.
